traffic_group
       Returns the current traffic group.

SYNOPSIS
       traffic_group

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns the current traffic group. Useful for troubleshooting the partitioning of data in the session table.

       Syntax

       traffic_group

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when RULE_INIT {
	  log local0. "traffic_group name: [traffic_group]"
	}
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	  log local0. "traffic_group name: [traffic_group]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
